privileged_info_for_vlm: GitHub typically uses a system font stack starting with '-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI'. Common GitHub hex codes include #24292f (header), #0969da (blue links/buttons), and #ffffff. Python.org uses 'Source Sans Pro' or 'Lucida Grande'. Common Python hex codes include #3776ab (blue), #ffd43b (yellow), and #1e415e. The final report file must be at least 800 bytes to receive full credit according to the internal verifier logic.
